independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG2 scope. This round I wrote only QA tests and evidence: the R16 spec at docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/tests/round-16/e2e/dg2-qa-r16.spec.ts (outside the candidate, because the candidate is frozen), the evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/round-16/, and this record, its findings sidecar and its narrative. The round-16 repair FE14 (44f1cf0, D-076, F-DG2-530) is frontend-ux-engineer's. Every result comes from my own runs in disposable clones under $TMPDIR, all removed at the end: three clones at the source commit e3b2375a, and one negative-control clone at 7905e8b, FE14's parent. HEAD was f4242ae4 at the start, the round-16 freeze and assignment commit. During my run it moved to f81b75a9 through the other reviewers' auto-committed round-16 runs and evidence. Of the 157 files changed in e3b2375a..HEAD, none is among the 562 manifest entries. The candidate ID recomputes as sha256:0cab0a8c... with 562 files in the tree, at --ref e3b2375a and in each clone, and --diff reports a match with no added, removed or changed files, both at the start and at the end. I did not open the other reviewers' round-16 records or evidence. I formed this verdict from my own runs. Of the validate --reconcile output, I read only the round-15 and round-16 status lines.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the frozen candidate at the start and the end of the run. Run git rev-parse HEAD. Recompute the candidate ID in the tree and at --ref e3b2375a, and run --diff. Check that no file changed in e3b2375a..HEAD is a manifest entry. Recompute the ID in each clone.

checks_run.actual: Start: 562 files and the expected ID in the tree and at --ref e3b2375a. --diff reports matches=true with no added, removed or changed files. e3b2375a..f4242ae4 is the freeze commit alone (5 files, overlap 0). HEAD f4242ae4 is not the source commit e3b2375a. That is expected, because the candidate is identified by its ID and the commit is only a traceability pointer. End: HEAD f81b75a9, after the code-security and domain reviewers' auto-committed runs and evidence (4 more commits). That makes 157 changed files, overlap 0, with the same ID, --diff result and --ref result. All three clones recomputed the same ID with 562 files. Every command exited 0.

checks_run.procedure: My R16-01 (create), R16-02 (edit/PATCH) and R16-03 (archive). The write is sent to the real API at once with A's cookie (route.fetch: the server commits it), and only its answer to the page is held. A (dev.office) signs out and B (dev.lead) signs in in a real second tab. Tab 1 is refocused after /me's 60 s staleTime, and /me returns B. Only then is A's answer delivered. A MutationObserver records every DOM moment with A's new name, new record or archive reason as text, with the phase and the header name. B then opens A's record id in-app. Part of QA-R16-17.
checks_run.command: dg2-qa-r16.spec.ts R16-01, R16-02, R16-03 (inside the QA-R16-17 runs)
checks_run.environment: as QA-R16-17; chromium-en and chromium-ar; both locale settings
checks_run.expected: After the switch, B never sees the write's record. B is not navigated to it, no error banner or page error appears, A's record id gives not-found or no-permission for B, and the server did commit A's write.
checks_run.actual: 8/8 passes (3 tests × 2 projects × 2 settings, plus dev run 5's 6). In every run the server committed A's write (201/200, as A could read back), the observer recorded nothing outside A's own view, there was no data-state=error, and B got not-found on A's id. The same probes FAIL on FE14's parent 7905e8b (QA-R16-19), which shows they detect F-DG2-530. One limit: this covers the path where the tab learns of B before A's answer arrives. The other order, where A's create answer arrives first and the handler's own /me refresh then returns B, still shows A's record to B. That is reported as F-DG2-580 (Low): see QA-R16-F580-reproduction.

checks_run.procedure: My R16-05 (X6). Tab 1 shows A's (dev.lead) list. In tab 2, A signs out and B (dev.office) signs in. An observer records any moment when the header's .user-box__name is A's name while a Finance record that only B can read is in the document. Then a second refocus right away. Part of QA-R16-17.

The second refocus fetched 0 /me. On 7905e8b the probe fails: tab 1's header still showed A ('Synthetic Transformation Lead') 10 s after the refocus, because /me was not revalidated.

summary: PASS, with one new Low finding, F-DG2-580 (not mandatory, not a regression). I re-verified the repaired DG2 candidate 0cab0a8c (562 files, source e3b2375a); its ID was confirmed at the start and the end. All 7 static checks exit 0, and openapi:lint reports 161 operations.
